title: How to Use AI for Small Business Marketing

facts.fact: According to Statista as cited on the page, 90% of business and marketing professionals across 35 countries say they now use AI in their marketing activities.
facts.quote: 90% of business and marketing professionals across 35 countries say they now use AI in their marketing activities.

facts.fact: According to Statista as cited on the page, 88% of surveyed business and marketing professionals believe AI is key to delivering personalized marketing experiences.
facts.quote: 88% of them believe AI is key to delivering personalized marketing experiences.

facts.fact: According to Statista as cited on the page, 55% of U.S. B2B marketers use AI tools specifically to generate leads.
facts.quote: In the U.S., 55% of B2B marketers use AI tools specifically to generate leads.

facts.fact: According to Statista as cited on the page, 52% of respondents say AI has significantly improved both the speed and efficiency of their marketing work.
facts.quote: 52% say AI has significantly improved both the speed and efficiency of their marketing work.

facts.fact: According to Statista as cited on the page, globally 87% of organizations believe AI technologies will give them a competitive edge, including in marketing.
facts.quote: Globally, 87% of organizations believe that AI technologies will give them a competitive edge—including in marketing.

facts.fact: The page's author claims that the 'vibe marketing' approach uses a selected suite of AI tools that do 80% of the marketing work, with the user guiding direction and final polish; this is the author's own claim, not a sourced statistic.
facts.quote: a carefully selected suite of AI tools that do 80% of the work
